description: Operational interfaces where domain terms and lifecycle distinctions are part of the user's job.

cases.context: 数据治理后台的候选样本列表。候选、隔离和已入集是三个不同的真实状态；当前列表只包含候选样本。

inputCopy.text: 运营验收阶段：先看 candidate，再推进入集闭环。

verifiedFacts: 当前列表包含 12 个候选样本
另有 3 个样本处于隔离状态
候选、隔离和已入集具有不同治理含义
mustPreservePropositions: 保留候选样本这一领域名称
候选为 12 个，隔离为 3 个
不能把候选描述成已经入集
mustRemoveIntents: 向运营人员展示验收阶段和闭环推进话术
中英文混用同一个候选概念
mustNotInfer: 隔离样本已被删除或拒绝
当前用户拥有入集权限
layoutConstraints: 状态计数必须能逐项扫描
保留后台的紧凑信息密度
cases.rationale: 守卫应删除团队流程话术，但不能因 candidate 像开发术语就抹掉真实治理概念。

cases.context: An operations release queue. A release is approved but not deployed. Only release managers can deploy; this viewer can inspect the record.

inputCopy.text: Approval gate passed; execute the delivery path

verifiedFacts: The release has not been deployed
The current viewer can inspect the release record
mustPreservePropositions: Approved and deployed remain distinct states
Viewing the release record is available
mustRemoveIntents: Expose internal gate and delivery-path instructions
mustNotInfer: The release is live or deployment has started
The viewer can deploy or request deployment
layoutConstraints: Status and permission must be visible without opening the record
cases.rationale: Operations copy can be concise without collapsing materially different lifecycle states or permissions.
